metadata.taxonomy_basis: Fagor CNC 8055 Error Manual + SAE J2012 MID/PID/FMI

1.name: CRITICAL
1.action: Immediate machine stop. Do not restart without authorised technician inspection.

2.name: MAJOR
2.action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.

3.name: SERIOUS
3.action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.

4.name: MODERATE
4.action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.

5.name: MINOR
5.action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.

6.name: WARNING
6.action: Log event. No immediate action required. Review at end of shift.

7.name: NOTICE
7.action: Informational. Parameter approaching limit. Review during next maintenance window.

8.name: ADVISORY
8.action: Performance advisory only. No maintenance action required.

SPN-CR-001.title: Spindle Bearing Catastrophic Failure
SPN-CR-001.description: Spindle bearing has reached catastrophic failure threshold. Vibration RMS on spindle exceeds 11.2 mm/s with kurtosis index >20. Continued operation risks spindle shaft damage and workpiece ejection.
SPN-CR-001.probable_cause: Bearing race spalling, loss of lubrication, contamination ingress, or end-of-life fatigue. May follow undetected progression through WN-060 and MN-061 warnings.
diagnostic_steps: Stop spindle immediately and lock out/tag out
Measure bearing vibration with handheld analyser at spindle nose
Inspect spindle cooling lines for blockage
Check oil mist lubrication nozzle P040
Review vibration trend log for P004 over prior 72 hours
SPN-CR-001.remedy: Replace spindle bearing set. Re-grease per OEM specification. Run acceptance test program SPD-TEST-001 before production restart.
SPN-CR-001.required_action: Immediate machine stop. Do not restart without authorised technician inspection.

SPN-CR-002.title: Spindle Drive Overcurrent — Hard Fault
SPN-CR-002.description: Spindle drive current exceeded 145% of rated value for more than 200ms. Drive has tripped on hardware overcurrent protection. P002 read {val} % (limit 105%).
SPN-CR-002.probable_cause: Spindle motor short circuit, drive IGBT failure, or mechanical seizure of spindle bearings. Distinguish from thermal overcurrent SPN-MJ-005.
diagnostic_steps: Do not reset drive until root cause identified
Check spindle motor insulation resistance (megger test)
Inspect drive power stage for burn marks
Verify no mechanical obstruction in spindle bore
Check P005 torque log for sudden spike event
SPN-CR-002.remedy: Replace faulty drive module or motor depending on fault localisation. Verify DC bus voltage P090 is within spec before power-on.
SPN-CR-002.required_action: Immediate machine stop. Do not restart without authorised technician inspection.

SPN-CR-003.title: Spindle Orientation Failure — Tool Change Blocked
SPN-CR-003.description: Spindle failed to reach orientation position within timeout (5 s). Orientation error P006 = {val} deg (limit ±0.5 deg). Tool change cycle aborted to prevent ATC arm collision.
SPN-CR-003.probable_cause: Encoder signal loss, orientation proximity switch failure, or mechanical brake malfunction.
diagnostic_steps: Check spindle encoder cable continuity
Verify orientation switch target disk alignment
Inspect pneumatic brake actuation pressure
Test orientation cycle manually in JOG mode
Review parameter P082 for last NC block executed
SPN-CR-003.remedy: Replace encoder or repair signal cable. Re-teach orientation position parameter. Re-run tool change acceptance cycle TCS-TEST-002.
SPN-CR-003.required_action: Immediate machine stop. Do not restart without authorised technician inspection.

SPN-MJ-001.title: Spindle Motor Overtemperature
SPN-MJ-001.description: Spindle motor winding temperature P003 = {val} °C exceeds major threshold (85 °C). Thermal model predicts critical threshold (95 °C) in <15 minutes at current load.
SPN-MJ-001.probable_cause: Cooling fan failure, blocked air filter, excessive duty cycle, or degraded motor winding insulation.
diagnostic_steps: Check spindle cooling fan rotation
Inspect and clean air filter on motor housing
Verify coolant-through-spindle flow if equipped
Reduce spindle load P002 by lowering feed rate
Check ambient temperature P070
SPN-MJ-001.remedy: Replace cooling fan motor. Clean filters. If repeated, check motor insulation class and compare to duty cycle.
SPN-MJ-001.required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.

SPN-MJ-002.title: Spindle Bearing Vibration — Major Threshold Exceeded
SPN-MJ-002.description: Spindle bearing vibration P004 = {val} mm/s exceeds ISO 10816-3 Zone C limit (7.1 mm/s). Kurtosis index P064 = {val2} indicates bearing defect frequency component present.
SPN-MJ-002.probable_cause: Bearing inner or outer race defect, ball spall, or loss of preload. Consistent with tool_wear or spindle_bearing_fault events in operational data.
diagnostic_steps: Capture vibration spectrum via on-machine sensor
Compare dominant frequency to bearing defect frequencies (BPFO, BPFI, BSF)
Check spindle thermal growth compensation active
Inspect tool holder for imbalance
Review trend for P004 over prior 30 days
SPN-MJ-002.remedy: Schedule spindle bearing replacement within 8 hours. Reduce spindle speed by 30% until replacement. Do not run over 6000 RPM.
SPN-MJ-002.required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.

SPN-MJ-003.title: Spindle Load Anomaly — Possible Tool Breakage
SPN-MJ-003.description: Spindle load P002 jumped from baseline by >40% within one NC block. P005 torque = {val} Nm. Pattern consistent with sudden tool breakage during milling operation.
SPN-MJ-003.probable_cause: Tool fracture due to worn cutting edges, excessive depth of cut, incorrect tool material, or coolant failure at cutting zone.
diagnostic_steps: Halt program and inspect tool in spindle
Check tool length with probe if available
Review P033 coolant level and P030 flow rate
Inspect workpiece surface for gouging
Review NC block G-code for programmed depth of cut
SPN-MJ-003.remedy: Replace broken or worn tool. Verify tool offset in tool table. Run first-off inspection before resuming production.
SPN-MJ-003.required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.

SPN-MJ-004.title: Regenerative Chatter — Stability Limit Exceeded
SPN-MJ-004.description: Vibration pattern on X/Y/Z axes indicates regenerative chatter. Dominant frequency {val} Hz matches spindle-speed-to-tooth-passing ratio. Crest factor P063 = {val2}.
SPN-MJ-004.probable_cause: Operating at unstable depth-of-cut for current spindle speed and tool geometry. May worsen with tool wear.
diagnostic_steps: Record dominant chatter frequency from vibration log
Apply stability lobe diagram for tool/fixture combination
Check workpiece clamping force
Inspect tool holder taper contact for fretting
Review programmed RPM P001 vs stability lobe chart
SPN-MJ-004.remedy: Adjust spindle speed by ±10% to shift operating point to stable lobe. Reduce axial depth of cut. Consider high-damping tool holder.
SPN-MJ-004.required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.

SPN-MJ-005.title: Spindle Drive Thermal Overcurrent
SPN-MJ-005.description: Drive reports thermal overcurrent condition. Motor current P002 sustained at {val}% for >60 s. Drive will shut down in {val2} s if condition persists.
SPN-MJ-005.probable_cause: Excessive cutting load, incorrect feed/speed parameters, or degraded drive cooling.
diagnostic_steps: Check drive heatsink temperature
Verify drive fan is operational
Inspect drive filter mat
Reduce programmed feed rate P083
Verify tool geometry matches material
SPN-MJ-005.remedy: Allow drive to cool (20 min minimum). Clean drive filters. If recurring, upgrade drive to next current rating.
SPN-MJ-005.required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.

SPN-SR-001.title: Spindle Load Gradually Increasing — Tool Wear Trend
SPN-SR-001.description: Spindle load P002 shows monotonic increase of {val}% over last 50 tool engagements. Pattern consistent with progressive tool flank wear. Current load {val2}%.
SPN-SR-001.probable_cause: Tool cutting edge wear beyond recommended tool life. Insufficient coolant delivery or incorrect cutting parameters accelerating wear.
diagnostic_steps: Inspect cutting edge under 10× loupe
Compare current tool life to OEM recommendation
Check coolant concentration (refractometer)
Review chip formation — short chips indicate worn tool
Trend P002 on same operation across last 20 parts
SPN-SR-001.remedy: Replace tool at next part completion. Update tool life counter in tool table. Optimise cutting parameters.
SPN-SR-001.required_action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.

SPN-SR-002.title: Spindle Speed Deviation — Encoder Signal Degraded
SPN-SR-002.description: Actual spindle speed deviates from commanded speed by >{val} RPM for >500 ms. Encoder signal shows {val2} missing pulses per revolution.
SPN-SR-002.probable_cause: Encoder disc contamination, bearing play causing encoder misalignment, or encoder cable shield failure causing EMI.
diagnostic_steps: Clean encoder disc with IPA
Check encoder mounting bolts torque
Inspect cable routing for pinch points
Measure signal quality on oscilloscope
Check cable shield continuity to ground
SPN-SR-002.remedy: Clean or replace encoder. Re-route cable away from power cables. Re-commission speed loop.
SPN-SR-002.required_action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.

SPN-SR-003.title: Bearing Kurtosis Threshold — Defect Initiation Detected
SPN-SR-003.description: Kurtosis index P064 = {val} has exceeded early-defect threshold (8.0). Statistical analysis of vibration signal indicates impulse-type events consistent with bearing defect initiation.
SPN-SR-003.probable_cause: Early-stage bearing race or rolling element defect. Expected remaining useful life: 200–500 operating hours depending on load.
diagnostic_steps: Enable continuous vibration trending for this spindle
Reduce spindle speed by 20% as precaution
Schedule borescope inspection at next planned downtime
Compare P064 trend rate of change to historical baseline
SPN-SR-003.remedy: Plan bearing replacement within 200 operating hours. Continue monitoring P064 daily. Reduce maximum spindle speed to 70% until replacement.
SPN-SR-003.required_action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.

SPN-MD-001.title: Spindle Load — Elevated Baseline
SPN-MD-001.description: Spindle load P002 baseline on operation {val} is {val2}% above historical mean for same program. No acute spike. Gradual trend suggests accumulating mechanical resistance.
SPN-MD-001.probable_cause: Tool wear progression, slight bearing preload increase, or minor misalignment.
diagnostic_steps: Compare current cycle time to nominal
Inspect tool visually for chip edge
Run dry cycle (spindle only, no feed) and check no-load current
Trend over next 20 cycles
SPN-MD-001.remedy: Schedule tool inspection at next shift change. Log in maintenance history.
SPN-MD-001.required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.

SPN-MD-002.title: Feed Override Active — Non-Standard Cutting Condition
SPN-MD-002.description: Feed override P083 set to {val}% (nominal 100%) during production program. Spindle speed P001 = {val2} RPM. Non-standard override active for >10 parts.
SPN-MD-002.probable_cause: Operator compensation for tool wear, material hardness variation, or unresolved vibration issue.
diagnostic_steps: Interview operator for reason override was applied
Check if override masks a recurring alarm
Verify correct tool is loaded in spindle
Review last SPC data for dimension drift
SPN-MD-002.remedy: Restore nominal feed rate. If override required for quality, initiate cutting parameter review with process engineer.
SPN-MD-002.required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.

SPN-MN-001.title: Spindle Load — Upper Advisory Threshold
SPN-MN-001.description: Spindle load P002 = {val}% is above upper advisory band (70%) but below major threshold. Sustained for {val2} minutes.
SPN-MN-001.probable_cause: Normal heavy-cut condition or early tool wear. Monitor for progression.
diagnostic_steps: Verify programmed depth of cut is nominal
Check tool life counter remaining
Monitor for next 10 cycles
SPN-MN-001.remedy: No immediate action. Log and monitor trend.
SPN-MN-001.required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.

SPN-MN-002.title: Spindle Motor Temperature — Elevated
SPN-MN-002.description: Spindle motor temperature P003 = {val} °C. Within normal range but {val2} °C above 30-day average for same duty cycle.
SPN-MN-002.probable_cause: Slight cooling degradation or increased duty cycle.
diagnostic_steps: Check air filter cleanliness
Verify coolant flow to motor if liquid-cooled
Compare ambient P070 to historical
SPN-MN-002.remedy: Clean filters at next shift break. Monitor trend.
SPN-MN-002.required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.

SPN-MN-003.title: Spindle Torque — Elevated During Entry Move
SPN-MN-003.description: Spindle torque P005 = {val} Nm during tool entry move. Exceeds expected entry torque model by {val2}%. Possible chip re-cutting or worn tool entry geometry.
SPN-MN-003.probable_cause: Insufficient chip evacuation at tool entry or worn tool corner radius.
diagnostic_steps: Check chip evacuation — increase coolant pressure P032
Inspect tool corner condition
Review approach strategy in NC program
SPN-MN-003.remedy: Adjust tool entry strategy (ramp instead of plunge). Inspect tool.
SPN-MN-003.required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.

SPN-MN-004.title: Vibration RMS — Gradual Increase Detected
SPN-MN-004.description: Vibration RMS P004 shows {val}% increase over last 7 days. Current value {val2} mm/s. Still within ISO Zone B (acceptable for long-term operation) but trend requires monitoring.
SPN-MN-004.probable_cause: Normal bearing wear progression or loosening of machine foundation bolts.
diagnostic_steps: Check and re-torque foundation bolts
Inspect ballscrew support bearing
Compare to factory acceptance vibration record
SPN-MN-004.remedy: Schedule preventive inspection at next planned maintenance. Document in maintenance log.
SPN-MN-004.required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.

SPN-WN-001.title: Spindle Load — Tool Life 80% Consumed
SPN-WN-001.description: Tool life counter for tool T{val} in spindle has reached 80% of programmed tool life. Spindle load P002 = {val2}%. Plan tool change before next scheduled run.
SPN-WN-001.probable_cause: Normal tool wear progression within expected life.
diagnostic_steps: Visually inspect tool at next opportunity
Verify tool life setting is calibrated to actual tool
Check surface finish on last produced part
SPN-WN-001.remedy: Prepare replacement tool. Schedule tool change at end of current batch.
SPN-WN-001.required_action: Log event. No immediate action required. Review at end of shift.

SPN-WN-002.title: Spindle Temperature — Warm-Up Reminder
SPN-WN-002.description: Machine has been idle >4 hours. Spindle temperature P003 = {val} °C. Run warm-up program SPD-WARMUP-001 before resuming production to avoid thermal shock to bearings.
SPN-WN-002.probable_cause: Standard thermal management — bearing preload changes with temperature.
diagnostic_steps: Check ambient temperature P070
Verify warm-up program is loaded in CNC memory
SPN-WN-002.remedy: Execute spindle warm-up program (15 min). Do not exceed 30% of maximum speed during first 5 minutes.
SPN-WN-002.required_action: Log event. No immediate action required. Review at end of shift.

SPN-WN-003.title: Tool Life Counter — Approaching Limit
SPN-WN-003.description: Tool T{val} has reached {val2}% of programmed tool life. Spindle load trend is stable. Tool change recommended before next production shift.
diagnostic_steps: Inspect tool surface condition
Confirm replacement tool is available in magazine
SPN-WN-003.remedy: Schedule tool change at shift end.
SPN-WN-003.required_action: Log event. No immediate action required. Review at end of shift.

SPN-WN-004.title: Spindle Load Variance — Increased Part-to-Part Variation
SPN-WN-004.description: Spindle load P002 standard deviation across last 20 parts has increased by {val}% vs. baseline. Mean load unchanged. Variability indicates inconsistent cutting condition.
SPN-WN-004.probable_cause: Workpiece material hardness variation, inconsistent clamping, or intermittent coolant delivery.
diagnostic_steps: Check material certificate for hardness specification
Inspect fixture clamping force with hydraulic gauge
Verify coolant nozzle position
SPN-WN-004.remedy: Investigate material batch. Verify fixture setup procedure.
SPN-WN-004.required_action: Log event. No immediate action required. Review at end of shift.

SPN-NC-001.title: Spindle Speed Program Limit Active
SPN-NC-001.description: Active NC program has set spindle speed limit to {val} RPM via G50 command. Maximum achievable P001 = {val2} RPM for this operation.
SPN-NC-001.probable_cause: Programmed speed limit for fixture or tool safety.
diagnostic_steps: Confirm speed limit is intentional in NC program
Verify tool/fixture speed rating
SPN-NC-001.remedy: No action required unless limit is unintentional.
SPN-NC-001.required_action: Informational. Parameter approaching limit. Review during next maintenance window.

SPN-NC-002.title: Spindle Warm-Up Complete
SPN-NC-002.description: Spindle warm-up cycle complete. Motor temperature P003 = {val} °C. Machine ready for production at full speed.
SPN-NC-002.remedy: No action required. Proceed with production.
SPN-NC-002.required_action: Informational. Parameter approaching limit. Review during next maintenance window.

SPN-AD-001.title: Spindle Running at Reduced Speed — Override Active
SPN-AD-001.description: Spindle running at {val} RPM with feed override P083 at {val2}%. Performance advisory only.
SPN-AD-001.required_action: Performance advisory only. No maintenance action required.

SPN-AD-002.title: Spindle Idle — No Load Detected
SPN-AD-002.description: Spindle running at programmed speed but P002 load = {val}%. No cutting engagement detected. Tool may be in air or rapid traversal block.
SPN-AD-002.required_action: Performance advisory only. No maintenance action required.

AXS-CR-001.title: Axis Following Error — Emergency Stop
AXS-CR-001.description: Axis following error P016 = {val} mm exceeds emergency stop threshold (2.0 mm). All axes halted. Position integrity cannot be guaranteed. P010={val2}, P011={val3}, P012={val4} mm.
AXS-CR-001.probable_cause: Drive fault, ball screw failure, axis collision, or encoder loss.
diagnostic_steps: Do not move axes until cause identified
Check all servo drive status LEDs
Verify no mechanical obstruction on axis
Inspect ball screw for damage
Check encoder feedback signal integrity
AXS-CR-001.remedy: Identify faulted axis. Repair mechanical cause. Re-home all axes before resuming.
AXS-CR-001.required_action: Immediate machine stop. Do not restart without authorised technician inspection.

AXS-CR-002.title: Servo Drive Hardware Fault — Axis Disabled
AXS-CR-002.description: Servo drive reports hardware fault on axis. Drive has disabled output stage. P013={val}A (X), P014={val2}A (Y), P015={val3}A (Z).
AXS-CR-002.probable_cause: IGBT overcurrent, DC bus undervoltage, or drive internal fault.
diagnostic_steps: Check drive status display for specific sub-code
Measure DC bus voltage P090
Inspect drive power connections
Check motor phase resistance balance
AXS-CR-002.remedy: Replace faulted drive. Verify motor winding integrity before re-enabling.
AXS-CR-002.required_action: Immediate machine stop. Do not restart without authorised technician inspection.

AXS-MJ-001.title: Axis Following Error — Major Limit
AXS-MJ-001.description: Following error P016 = {val} mm exceeds major threshold (0.5 mm). Cutting has been suspended. Position error on {val2}-axis.
AXS-MJ-001.probable_cause: Servo gain mismatch, mechanical friction increase, or ball screw backlash.
diagnostic_steps: Check servo gain parameters vs commissioning record
Inspect axis guide lubrication
Measure backlash on ball screw
Run servo tuning cycle
AXS-MJ-001.remedy: Re-tune servo gain. Lubricate linear guides. If backlash >0.02mm, schedule ball screw inspection.
AXS-MJ-001.required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.

AXS-MJ-002.title: Servo Drive Thermal Warning — Overtemperature
AXS-MJ-002.description: Servo drive temperature P017 = {val} °C exceeds 80°C. Drive will fault at 90°C. Current draw: X={val2}A, Y={val3}A, Z={val4}A.
AXS-MJ-002.probable_cause: Inadequate cabinet ventilation, blocked drive heatsink, or sustained high-load machining.
diagnostic_steps: Check cabinet fans are operational P071
Clean drive heatsink fins
Reduce duty cycle temporarily
Check ambient temperature P070
AXS-MJ-002.remedy: Restore cabinet ventilation. Clean filters. If recurring, upsize drive cooling.
AXS-MJ-002.required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.

AXS-SR-001.title: Axis Vibration — Resonance Detected
AXS-SR-001.description: Axis vibration on {val}-axis shows resonant frequency at {val2} Hz. Following error P016 = {val3} mm. Pattern consistent with chatter or axis mechanical resonance.
AXS-SR-001.probable_cause: Feed rate at resonant frequency, worn ball screw nut, or inadequate servo filter.
diagnostic_steps: Measure resonant frequency from vibration log
Check servo filter notch frequency setting
Inspect ball screw nut preload
Change feed rate by ±15% and observe effect
AXS-SR-001.remedy: Apply servo notch filter at resonant frequency. Inspect ball screw nut.
AXS-SR-001.required_action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.

AXS-SR-002.title: Servo Current — Elevated Load on Axis
AXS-SR-002.description: Servo current on {val}-axis P0{val2} = {val3} A, elevated {val4}% above baseline for equivalent move. Ball screw or guide resistance increasing.
AXS-SR-002.probable_cause: Insufficient lubrication on linear guides or ball screw, guide wear, or contamination ingress.
diagnostic_steps: Manually jog axis and feel for stiction
Inspect linear guide surface for scoring
Check lubrication oil delivery to guides P040
Review lubrication interval log
AXS-SR-002.remedy: Apply lubrication per maintenance schedule. If stiction persists, inspect guide rail and carriage.
AXS-SR-002.required_action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.

AXS-MD-001.title: Following Error — Elevated But Within Limit
AXS-MD-001.description: Following error P016 = {val} mm is elevated above advisory threshold (0.02 mm) but below halt limit. Trend over last 100 moves: increasing.
AXS-MD-001.probable_cause: Servo loop gain reduction or mechanical friction increase.
diagnostic_steps: Run test cycle and log P016 per block
Compare to commissioning baseline
Check guide lubrication
AXS-MD-001.remedy: Log and monitor. Schedule servo re-tuning if trend continues.
AXS-MD-001.required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.

AXS-MD-002.title: Servo Drive Temperature — Elevated
AXS-MD-002.description: Drive temperature P017 = {val} °C. Within spec but {val2} °C above seasonal baseline. Monitor for progression.
AXS-MD-002.probable_cause: Marginal cabinet cooling or increased cutting load.
diagnostic_steps: Check cabinet fan speed
Verify door seals are intact
AXS-MD-002.required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.

AXS-MN-001.title: Servo Current — Minor Variance
AXS-MN-001.description: Servo current on {val}-axis shows {val2}% variance vs. baseline on identical move profile. No limit exceeded.
AXS-MN-001.probable_cause: Normal mechanical variation or minor lubrication change.
diagnostic_steps: Monitor for 24 hours
Review lubrication log
AXS-MN-001.required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.

AXS-MN-002.title: Axis Vibration — Minor Threshold
AXS-MN-002.description: Axis vibration RMS on {val}-axis = {val2} mm/s. Above minor threshold (3.5 mm/s) but below major (7.1 mm/s).
AXS-MN-002.probable_cause: Tool wear induced vibration or minor chatter.
diagnostic_steps: Inspect tool condition
Try ±10% spindle speed
AXS-MN-002.remedy: Monitor and log. Inspect tool at next change.
AXS-MN-002.required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.

AXS-WN-001.title: Following Error — Intermittent Spikes
AXS-WN-001.description: Following error P016 shows intermittent spikes to {val} mm during direction reversals. Mean error within spec.
AXS-WN-001.probable_cause: Ball screw backlash or servo reversal compensation mismatch.
diagnostic_steps: Check backlash compensation parameter
Measure physical backlash with dial indicator
AXS-WN-001.remedy: Adjust backlash compensation parameter. If physical backlash >0.015mm, plan ball screw nut replacement.
AXS-WN-001.required_action: Log event. No immediate action required. Review at end of shift.

AXS-NC-001.title: Axis Position — Reference Established
AXS-NC-001.description: All axes homed successfully. X={val}, Y={val2}, Z={val3} mm from machine zero. Reference position confirmed.
AXS-NC-001.remedy: No action required. Machine ready for operation.
AXS-NC-001.required_action: Informational. Parameter approaching limit. Review during next maintenance window.

AXS-AD-001.title: Rapid Override Active
AXS-AD-001.description: Rapid traverse override P083 = {val}%. Axes moving at reduced rapid speed.
AXS-AD-001.required_action: Performance advisory only. No maintenance action required.

TCS-CR-001.title: ATC Arm Collision — Emergency Stop
TCS-CR-001.description: ATC arm detected unexpected resistance during swing cycle. Emergency stop activated. Magazine position P020 = slot {val}. Clamp pressure P021 = {val2} bar. Cycle time exceeded at T+{val3}s.
TCS-CR-001.probable_cause: Tool not seated correctly in spindle, obstructed magazine pocket, or broken ATC arm.
diagnostic_steps: Do not reset until area is clear and inspected
Check spindle bore for retained chip or damaged tool
Inspect ATC arm for physical damage
Verify magazine pocket is clear
Check pneumatic pressure to ATC cylinder
TCS-CR-001.remedy: Clear obstruction. Inspect and repair ATC arm if damaged. Re-run ATC cycle in manual step mode.
TCS-CR-001.required_action: Immediate machine stop. Do not restart without authorised technician inspection.

TCS-MJ-001.title: Tool Clamp Pressure — Below Minimum
TCS-MJ-001.description: Tool clamp pressure P021 = {val} bar, below minimum safe value (55 bar). Tool change aborted. Risk of tool ejection if machining continues.
TCS-MJ-001.probable_cause: Pneumatic supply pressure drop, clamp valve leakage, or draw-bar spring fatigue.
diagnostic_steps: Check pneumatic supply pressure at machine entry
Inspect clamp solenoid valve for leakage
Measure draw-bar pull force with tool pull gauge
Check air service unit filter/regulator
TCS-MJ-001.remedy: Restore pneumatic pressure. Replace draw-bar spring if pull force <12 kN. Do not machine until clamp pressure verified.
TCS-MJ-001.required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.

TCS-MJ-002.title: Tool Length Measurement — Out of Tolerance
TCS-MJ-002.description: In-process tool length measurement via touch probe reports P023 = {val} mm offset from stored value. Tolerance ±0.05 mm. Tool slot {val2}. Risk of dimensional error on workpiece.
TCS-MJ-002.probable_cause: Tool not fully seated, incorrect tool loaded, or tool breakage not detected by P002 load monitor.
diagnostic_steps: Inspect tool in spindle for seating
Verify tool ID matches NC program expectation
Re-measure with tool presetter offline
Check probe calibration
TCS-MJ-002.remedy: Re-seat tool and re-measure. If offset confirmed, update tool table and scrap/inspect last part.
TCS-MJ-002.required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.

TCS-SR-001.title: ATC Cycle Time — Degraded
TCS-SR-001.description: ATC arm cycle time P022 = {val} s, exceeds nominal {val2} s by >20%. Clamp pressure P021 = {val3} bar.
TCS-SR-001.probable_cause: ATC cylinder seal wear, lubrication degradation, or magazine drive motor wear.
diagnostic_steps: Run 5 consecutive ATC cycles and log P022
Check ATC lubrication grease condition
Measure air cylinder actuation force
Inspect magazine drive gearbox
TCS-SR-001.remedy: Grease ATC arm pivot. If cycle time continues degrading, replace ATC cylinder seals.
TCS-SR-001.required_action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.

TCS-MD-001.title: Magazine Tool Count — Inventory Discrepancy
TCS-MD-001.description: CNC tool table shows {val} tools; magazine sensor count = {val2}. Discrepancy of {val3} tools. Risk of calling empty pocket.
TCS-MD-001.probable_cause: Tool loaded without updating tool table, or tool removed manually without clearing table entry.
diagnostic_steps: Run magazine inventory check program
Physically verify each occupied pocket vs. tool table
Check for manual tool removal log entries
TCS-MD-001.remedy: Reconcile tool table with physical magazine. Clear empty pocket entries.
TCS-MD-001.required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.

TCS-MN-001.title: Magazine Pocket — Tool Life Expired
TCS-MN-001.description: Tool in magazine slot {val} has exceeded 100% of programmed tool life. Tool will not be called by NC program until life counter is reset.
diagnostic_steps: Inspect tool before resetting counter
Confirm replacement is in magazine
TCS-MN-001.required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.

TCS-WN-001.title: Next Tool Pre-Call — Long ATC Cycle Expected
TCS-WN-001.description: Next tool T{val} is in magazine slot {val2}, requiring full magazine rotation of {val3} positions. ATC pre-call initiated.
TCS-WN-001.probable_cause: Normal magazine logistics based on program sequence.
TCS-WN-001.required_action: Log event. No immediate action required. Review at end of shift.

TCS-NC-001.title: Tool Change Complete
TCS-NC-001.description: ATC cycle completed successfully. Tool T{val} in spindle. Cycle time P022 = {val2} s. Magazine at position {val3}.
TCS-NC-001.required_action: Informational. Parameter approaching limit. Review during next maintenance window.

TCS-AD-001.title: Magazine Position Update
TCS-AD-001.description: Magazine indexed to reference position {val} after power-on.
TCS-AD-001.required_action: Performance advisory only. No maintenance action required.

CLS-CR-001.title: Coolant Flow Loss — Emergency Stop
CLS-CR-001.description: Coolant flow P030 = {val} L/min (below minimum 5 L/min). Coolant tank level P033 = {val2}%. Machine stopped to prevent tool and workpiece thermal damage.
CLS-CR-001.probable_cause: Coolant pump failure, blocked filter, ruptured hose, or empty tank.
diagnostic_steps: Check coolant tank level physically
Inspect pump operation (audible)
Check coolant supply hose for kinking or rupture
Inspect coolant filter element differential pressure
Verify pump motor circuit breaker
CLS-CR-001.remedy: Restore coolant supply. Replace pump if failed. Do not restart machining until minimum flow P030 >15 L/min confirmed.
CLS-CR-001.required_action: Immediate machine stop. Do not restart without authorised technician inspection.

CLS-MJ-001.title: Coolant Overtemperature
CLS-MJ-001.description: Coolant temperature P031 = {val} °C, above major threshold (40 °C). Flow rate P030 = {val2} L/min. Thermal control of cutting zone compromised.
CLS-MJ-001.probable_cause: Chiller unit failure, high ambient temperature, excessive heat load from cutting, or inadequate coolant tank volume.
diagnostic_steps: Check chiller unit operation
Verify coolant tank volume is adequate
Inspect heat exchanger for fouling
Reduce cutting parameters to lower heat generation
CLS-MJ-001.remedy: Restore chiller operation. Clean heat exchanger. Allow coolant to cool before resuming heavy cuts.
CLS-MJ-001.required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.

CLS-SR-001.title: Coolant Pressure — Low
CLS-SR-001.description: Coolant pressure P032 = {val} bar, below lower advisory limit (4 bar). Flow rate P030 = {val2} L/min. Coolant-through-spindle delivery may be insufficient.
CLS-SR-001.probable_cause: Partially blocked filter, partially closed isolation valve, or pump cavitation from low tank level.
diagnostic_steps: Check filter differential pressure gauge
Verify all isolation valves open
Check tank level P033
Listen for pump cavitation (irregular noise)
CLS-SR-001.remedy: Replace coolant filter. Refill tank. Re-prime pump.
CLS-SR-001.required_action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.

CLS-MD-001.title: Coolant Tank Level — Low
CLS-MD-001.description: Coolant tank level P033 = {val}%. Below recommended operating level (25%). Machine will halt at 5%.
CLS-MD-001.probable_cause: Coolant consumption exceeds refill rate, or evaporation/drag-out.
diagnostic_steps: Check refractometer for coolant concentration
Inspect for leaks
Review coolant consumption log
CLS-MD-001.remedy: Top up coolant tank. Check concentration and adjust. Investigate consumption rate if elevated.
CLS-MD-001.required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.

CLS-MN-001.title: Coolant Flow — Minor Deviation
CLS-MN-001.description: Coolant flow P030 = {val} L/min, {val2}% below setpoint. Temperature P031 = {val3} °C. No immediate machining impact.
CLS-MN-001.probable_cause: Minor filter restriction or nozzle partial blockage.
diagnostic_steps: Inspect coolant nozzles for chip blockage
Check filter condition
CLS-MN-001.remedy: Clean nozzles. Schedule filter inspection at shift end.
CLS-MN-001.required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.

CLS-WN-001.title: Coolant Tank — Refill Reminder
CLS-WN-001.description: Coolant tank level P033 = {val}%. Refill recommended within {val2} hours based on consumption rate.
CLS-WN-001.remedy: Add coolant mix at correct concentration (check refractometer).
CLS-WN-001.required_action: Log event. No immediate action required. Review at end of shift.

CLS-NC-001.title: Coolant Temperature Stabilised
CLS-NC-001.description: Coolant temperature P031 = {val} °C. Within optimal range. Thermal equilibrium reached after {val2} minutes warm-up.
CLS-NC-001.remedy: No action required. Machine ready for production.
CLS-NC-001.required_action: Informational. Parameter approaching limit. Review during next maintenance window.

CLS-AD-001.title: Coolant — Through-Spindle Active
CLS-AD-001.description: Through-spindle coolant active. Flow P030 = {val} L/min at spindle nose.
CLS-AD-001.probable_cause: NC program M-code activated through-spindle coolant.
CLS-AD-001.required_action: Performance advisory only. No maintenance action required.

LUB-CR-001.title: Lubrication System Failure — Machine Stopped
LUB-CR-001.description: Lubrication oil pressure P040 = {val} bar (below critical minimum 0.5 bar). Oil level P041 = {val2}%. Continued operation will cause rapid guide and ball screw wear.
LUB-CR-001.probable_cause: Lubrication pump failure, empty reservoir, or blocked distributor.
diagnostic_steps: Check oil level in reservoir P041 physically
Listen for pump motor running
Check pump outlet pressure
Inspect progressive distributor piston movement
Check motor circuit breaker in electrical cabinet
LUB-CR-001.remedy: Restore lubrication system. Do not restart machine without verified lube pressure. After restoration, jog all axes 100mm to distribute oil before production.
LUB-CR-001.required_action: Immediate machine stop. Do not restart without authorised technician inspection.

LUB-MJ-001.title: Lubrication Pump — No Flow Confirmation
LUB-MJ-001.description: Lubrication pump current P042 = {val} A (pump running) but flow switch did not confirm delivery within {val2} s. P040 = {val3} bar.
LUB-MJ-001.probable_cause: Blocked oil distributor, closed isolation valve, or internal pump bypass.
diagnostic_steps: Check oil inlet strainer
Inspect distributor output at each lube point
Verify isolation valve position
Check for air lock in suction line
LUB-MJ-001.remedy: Clear blockage in distributor. Bleed air from suction. Replace pump if internal bypass confirmed.
LUB-MJ-001.required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.

LUB-SR-001.title: Lubrication Oil Level — Low
LUB-SR-001.description: Lubrication oil reservoir level P041 = {val}%. Below recommended level (25%). Lube interval may be affected. Machine will stop at 10%.
LUB-SR-001.probable_cause: Normal oil consumption or minor leak.
diagnostic_steps: Check for oil leaks at guide covers
Verify lube cycle interval setting
Check oil type matches specification
LUB-SR-001.remedy: Top up reservoir with correct oil grade. Inspect for leaks.
LUB-SR-001.required_action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.

LUB-MD-001.title: Lubrication Pressure — Marginal
LUB-MD-001.description: Lubrication delivery pressure P040 = {val} bar. Marginally above critical but {val2}% below nominal. Pump current P042 = {val3} A.
LUB-MD-001.probable_cause: Partially blocked strainer, slightly worn pump, or increased line restriction.
diagnostic_steps: Clean inlet strainer
Check pump discharge pressure with calibrated gauge
Inspect distributor for sticking piston
LUB-MD-001.remedy: Clean strainer. If pump discharge confirmed low, plan pump replacement at next maintenance.
LUB-MD-001.required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.

LUB-MN-001.title: Lubrication Pump Current — Elevated
LUB-MN-001.description: Pump current P042 = {val} A, {val2}% above baseline. Pump running but increased load detected.
LUB-MN-001.probable_cause: Increased oil viscosity (cold start), partial line restriction.
diagnostic_steps: Check oil temperature
Confirm oil grade matches viscosity specification
LUB-MN-001.remedy: Allow machine to warm up. Monitor for 30 minutes.
LUB-MN-001.required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.

LUB-WN-001.title: Lubrication — Scheduled Interval Due
LUB-WN-001.description: Lubrication cycle interval counter has reached {val} hours since last full service. Lube point inspection recommended.
diagnostic_steps: Inspect all lube points for oil film
Check distribution block operation
LUB-WN-001.remedy: Perform lubrication inspection per maintenance checklist MAINT-LUB-001.
LUB-WN-001.required_action: Log event. No immediate action required. Review at end of shift.

LUB-NC-001.title: Lubrication Cycle Complete
LUB-NC-001.description: Scheduled lubrication cycle delivered. P040 = {val} bar confirmed. Pump current P042 = {val2} A. Next cycle in {val3} min.
LUB-NC-001.required_action: Informational. Parameter approaching limit. Review during next maintenance window.

LUB-AD-001.title: Lubrication Oil Level — Nominal
LUB-AD-001.description: Oil level P041 = {val}%. Lubrication system operating normally.
LUB-AD-001.required_action: Performance advisory only. No maintenance action required.

VIB-CR-001.title: Vibration — ISO Zone D — Machine Stop
VIB-CR-001.description: Vibration RMS exceeds ISO 10816-3 Zone D limit (11.2 mm/s). X={val}, Y={val2}, Z={val3} mm/s. Crest factor P063={val4}. Kurtosis P064={val5}. Machine stopped.
VIB-CR-001.probable_cause: Catastrophic bearing failure, tool breakage, workpiece ejection, or structure loosening.
diagnostic_steps: Do not restart until vibration source identified
Check spindle for mechanical damage
Inspect machine bed levelling
Verify workpiece is still clamped
Check foundation bolts
VIB-CR-001.remedy: Identify and repair vibration source before restart. Full machine inspection required.
VIB-CR-001.required_action: Immediate machine stop. Do not restart without authorised technician inspection.

VIB-MJ-001.title: Vibration — ISO Zone C — Major Alert
VIB-MJ-001.description: Vibration RMS has entered ISO Zone C (7.1–11.2 mm/s). X={val}, Y={val2}, Z={val3} mm/s. Crest P063={val4}. Long-term operation at this level will cause bearing damage.
VIB-MJ-001.probable_cause: Advanced tool wear, bearing defect, or machine structural loosening.
diagnostic_steps: Perform spectral analysis if portable analyser available
Inspect tool immediately
Check machine foundation
Review trending from last 48 hours
VIB-MJ-001.remedy: Reduce cutting parameters. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.
VIB-MJ-001.required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.

VIB-SR-001.title: Vibration — ISO Zone B Upper — Elevated
VIB-SR-001.description: Vibration RMS = {val} mm/s on {val2}-axis. At upper boundary of ISO Zone B (4.5–7.1 mm/s). Acceptable for limited operation but not long-term.
VIB-SR-001.probable_cause: Moderate tool wear, fixture loosening, or minor bearing degradation.
diagnostic_steps: Inspect tool condition
Check fixture clamping
Review spindle speed vs stability lobe
Measure bearing temperature
VIB-SR-001.remedy: Inspect and replace tool. Re-verify fixture. Monitor for further increase.
VIB-SR-001.required_action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.

VIB-MD-001.title: Crest Factor — Elevated Above Baseline
VIB-MD-001.description: Vibration crest factor P063 = {val} on spindle sensor. Kurtosis P064 = {val2}. Both elevated vs. 30-day baseline. Pattern may indicate early bearing defect or tool imbalance.
VIB-MD-001.probable_cause: Incipient bearing defect, tool imbalance, or minor structural change.
diagnostic_steps: Compare to historical baseline for same operation
Inspect tool holder for contamination in taper
Check tool balance if >12000 RPM operation
VIB-MD-001.remedy: Log and monitor daily. Inspect tool holder taper. Plan bearing inspection at next opportunity.
VIB-MD-001.required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.

VIB-MN-001.title: Kurtosis Index — Rising Trend
VIB-MN-001.description: Kurtosis index P064 = {val}. Trending upward over last 14 days: +{val2}% per week. Currently in early-warning zone (5.0–8.0).
VIB-MN-001.probable_cause: Early-stage bearing defect initiation or accumulating surface fatigue.
diagnostic_steps: Enable high-frequency logging on spindle vibration
Review full spectrum for defect frequencies
VIB-MN-001.remedy: Schedule detailed inspection at next planned downtime. Continue monitoring.
VIB-MN-001.required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.

VIB-WN-001.title: Vibration — Normal Operating Range
VIB-WN-001.description: All axes within ISO Zone A (<2.3 mm/s). X={val}, Y={val2}, Z={val3} mm/s. Machine operating in optimal vibration envelope.
VIB-WN-001.required_action: Log event. No immediate action required. Review at end of shift.

VIB-NC-001.title: Crest Factor — Within Normal Band
VIB-NC-001.description: Vibration crest factor P063 = {val}. Within normal operating band (1.0–4.5). No bearing defect signature detected.
VIB-NC-001.required_action: Informational. Parameter approaching limit. Review during next maintenance window.

VIB-AD-001.title: Vibration Baseline Update
VIB-AD-001.description: Vibration baseline recalculated from last 30-day dataset. New baseline: X={val}, Y={val2}, Z={val3} mm/s.
VIB-AD-001.required_action: Performance advisory only. No maintenance action required.

ELC-CR-001.title: DC Bus Undervoltage — All Drives Disabled
ELC-CR-001.description: DC bus voltage P090 = {val} V, below minimum {val2} V. All servo and spindle drives disabled. Main supply P091 = {val3} V.
ELC-CR-001.probable_cause: Main supply phase loss, incoming fuse blown, or DC bus capacitor failure.
diagnostic_steps: Check main incoming supply voltage at isolator
Measure all three phases for balance
Inspect main fuses and circuit breakers
Check DC bus capacitor bank for bulging
ELC-CR-001.remedy: Restore supply. Replace fuse if blown. Capacitor replacement requires qualified electrician.
ELC-CR-001.required_action: Immediate machine stop. Do not restart without authorised technician inspection.

ELC-MJ-001.title: Supply Voltage — Out of Tolerance
ELC-MJ-001.description: Main supply voltage P091 = {val} V. Outside ±10% tolerance band ({val2}–{val3} V). DC bus P090 = {val4} V.
ELC-MJ-001.probable_cause: Site power quality issue, undersized transformer, or high demand on shared bus.
diagnostic_steps: Measure voltage at main incoming terminal
Check transformer tap setting
Contact facility electrical team
Log time of occurrence vs. site load profile
ELC-MJ-001.remedy: Notify facility maintenance. Install line conditioner if recurring.
ELC-MJ-001.required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.

ELC-SR-001.title: Ground Leakage — Elevated
ELC-SR-001.description: Ground leakage current P092 = {val} mA, above advisory threshold (10 mA). Risk of nuisance RCD tripping.
ELC-SR-001.probable_cause: Degraded motor winding insulation, cable damage, or moisture ingress.
diagnostic_steps: Perform insulation resistance test on all motor cables
Inspect cable entry points for moisture
Check RCD rating vs measured leakage
ELC-SR-001.remedy: Locate and repair insulation fault. Replace damaged cables.
ELC-SR-001.required_action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.

ELC-MD-001.title: UPS Battery — Low Charge
ELC-MD-001.description: UPS battery level P093 = {val}%. Battery backup time estimated {val2} minutes. CNC memory protection duration may be insufficient for extended power outage.
ELC-MD-001.probable_cause: Battery aging, recent extended power interruption, or battery charger fault.
diagnostic_steps: Check UPS charger LED status
Measure battery float voltage
Check battery age against replacement schedule (typically 3–5 years)
ELC-MD-001.remedy: Recharge UPS. If charge does not recover to >80% within 24h, replace battery.
ELC-MD-001.required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.

ELC-MN-001.title: Electrical Cabinet Temperature — Elevated
ELC-MN-001.description: Cabinet temperature P071 = {val} °C. Above minor threshold (40 °C) but below major (55 °C).
ELC-MN-001.probable_cause: Cabinet fan partial failure, clogged filter, or high ambient temperature.
diagnostic_steps: Check cabinet fan operation
Clean filter mats
Verify cabinet door seals
ELC-MN-001.required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.

ELC-WN-001.title: DC Bus — Minor Voltage Ripple Detected
ELC-WN-001.description: DC bus voltage P090 shows increased ripple: peak-to-peak = {val} V (limit 15 V). Mean voltage {val2} V within spec.
ELC-WN-001.probable_cause: Aging DC bus capacitors or increased regenerative energy.
diagnostic_steps: Measure capacitance of DC bus capacitors
Check for excessive regenerative braking events
ELC-WN-001.remedy: Monitor. Plan capacitor inspection at next scheduled maintenance.
ELC-WN-001.required_action: Log event. No immediate action required. Review at end of shift.

ELC-NC-001.title: Power-On Self-Test — Passed
ELC-NC-001.description: All electrical systems passed POST. DC bus P090={val}V, supply P091={val2}V. System ready.
ELC-NC-001.required_action: Informational. Parameter approaching limit. Review during next maintenance window.

ELC-AD-001.title: UPS Battery — Fully Charged
ELC-AD-001.description: UPS battery at {val}% capacity. Backup time: {val2} minutes.
ELC-AD-001.required_action: Performance advisory only. No maintenance action required.

THM-CR-001.title: Multi-Zone Overtemperature — Emergency Stop
THM-CR-001.description: Multiple thermal zones simultaneously over critical threshold. Spindle P003={val}°C, servo P017={val2}°C, cabinet P071={val3}°C, motor P072={val4}°C. Machine stopped.
THM-CR-001.probable_cause: Chiller failure, blocked ventilation, or ambient temperature event.
diagnostic_steps: Check ambient temperature in machine area
Verify all cooling fans active
Check chiller unit
Inspect all air filters
THM-CR-001.remedy: Restore cooling. Do not restart until all zones below 70% of critical threshold.
THM-CR-001.required_action: Immediate machine stop. Do not restart without authorised technician inspection.

THM-MD-001.title: Thermal Gradient — Elevated Ambient
THM-MD-001.description: Ambient temperature P070 = {val} °C. Cabinet P071 = {val2} °C. Feed motor P072 = {val3} °C. All within spec but elevated vs seasonal baseline.
THM-MD-001.probable_cause: HVAC system in machine area running below capacity or unusual ambient conditions.
diagnostic_steps: Check room HVAC status
Verify all machine air filters clean
Review duty cycle vs. thermal model
THM-MD-001.remedy: Request HVAC inspection for machine area. Clean all filters.
THM-MD-001.required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.

THM-WN-001.title: Ambient Temperature — Above Recommended Range
THM-WN-001.description: Ambient temperature P070 = {val} °C, above recommended operating range (35°C). Machine can operate but thermal compensation active.
THM-WN-001.probable_cause: Seasonal high temperatures or HVAC reduced capacity.
diagnostic_steps: Confirm HVAC is functional
Increase frequency of coolant concentration checks
THM-WN-001.remedy: Monitor thermal parameters. Consider running reduced duty cycle during peak heat hours.
THM-WN-001.required_action: Log event. No immediate action required. Review at end of shift.

THM-NC-001.title: Thermal Compensation Active
THM-NC-001.description: CNC thermal error compensation is active. Ambient P070={val}°C, spindle P003={val2}°C. Axis offsets automatically adjusted for thermal expansion.
THM-NC-001.remedy: No action required. Monitor part quality.
THM-NC-001.required_action: Informational. Parameter approaching limit. Review during next maintenance window.

THM-AD-001.title: Feed Motor Temperature — Nominal
THM-AD-001.description: Feed motor temperature P072 = {val} °C. Within optimal band.
THM-AD-001.required_action: Performance advisory only. No maintenance action required.

CNC-CR-001.title: CNC Controller — Watchdog Timeout
CNC-CR-001.description: CNC real-time kernel watchdog timed out. All motion halted. CPU load at time of fault: P080={val}%. Memory P081={val2}%.
CNC-CR-001.probable_cause: Software exception in motion planner, hardware interrupt overload, or memory corruption.
diagnostic_steps: Record fault dump from CNC system log
Check for recent software updates
Verify RAM hardware via POST diagnostics
Check CPU temperature
CNC-CR-001.remedy: Reboot CNC controller. If recurring, contact CNC manufacturer support with fault dump. Do not restart machine with persistent watchdog faults.
CNC-CR-001.required_action: Immediate machine stop. Do not restart without authorised technician inspection.

CNC-MJ-001.title: NC Program — Syntax Error at Block
CNC-MJ-001.description: NC program execution halted at block N{val}. P082={val}. Syntax error detected: illegal G-code combination or out-of-range parameter.
CNC-MJ-001.probable_cause: Incorrect NC program modification, corrupted file transfer, or unsupported G-code for this CNC model.
diagnostic_steps: Review NC block P082 in program editor
Check G-code reference manual for supported codes
Re-transfer program from CAM system
Run program in single-block test mode
CNC-MJ-001.remedy: Correct NC program. Re-verify with dry run before production restart.
CNC-MJ-001.required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.

CNC-SR-001.title: CNC CPU Load — High
CNC-SR-001.description: CNC CPU load P080 = {val}% sustained over last {val2} minutes. May cause motion interpolation jitter if load exceeds 90%.
CNC-SR-001.probable_cause: Complex NC program with many small blocks, excessive macro execution, or background task conflict.
diagnostic_steps: Check number of active background tasks
Review NC program block density
Disable unnecessary data logging during critical cuts
Check for DNC streaming vs. stored program
CNC-SR-001.remedy: Optimise NC program (increase minimum arc chord tolerance). Use stored program instead of DNC stream.
CNC-SR-001.required_action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.

CNC-MD-011.title: CNC Memory — Program Storage Near Full
CNC-MD-011.description: CNC program memory P081 = {val}%. Less than {val2} MB available. Large programs may not load.
diagnostic_steps: Review program list for obsolete programs
Archive and delete old programs
CNC-MD-011.remedy: Delete or archive old NC programs. Maintain minimum 20% free memory.
CNC-MD-011.required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.

CNC-MN-001.title: Feed Override — Non-100% Setting
CNC-MN-001.description: Feed override P083 = {val}% (nominal 100%). Machine running at non-standard feed rate.
diagnostic_steps: Confirm override is intentional
Check if masking a vibration or quality issue
CNC-MN-001.remedy: Restore to 100% if not intentional. Log reason if intentional.
CNC-MN-001.required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.

CNC-WN-001.title: Program — Approaching End of File
CNC-WN-001.description: NC program at block N{val}, approaching end. {val2} blocks remaining.
CNC-WN-001.required_action: Log event. No immediate action required. Review at end of shift.

CNC-NC-001.title: CNC System — Normal Operation
CNC-NC-001.description: CNC controller operating normally. CPU P080={val}%, memory P081={val2}%. All axes enabled.
CNC-NC-001.required_action: Informational. Parameter approaching limit. Review during next maintenance window.

CNC-AD-001.title: NC Block Counter
CNC-AD-001.description: NC program execution at block N{val}. Advisory status update.
CNC-AD-001.required_action: Performance advisory only. No maintenance action required.

HYD-MJ-001.title: Hydraulic Pressure — Low
HYD-MJ-001.description: Hydraulic pressure P050 = {val} bar, below minimum operating pressure ({val2} bar). Workholding and ATC clamp functions may be unreliable.
HYD-MJ-001.probable_cause: Pump wear, pressure relief valve stuck open, or internal leak in hydraulic circuit.
diagnostic_steps: Check pump outlet pressure with calibrated gauge
Listen for pump bypass noise
Inspect hydraulic hoses and fittings for leaks
Check oil level in reservoir
Verify relief valve setting
HYD-MJ-001.remedy: Replace pump if output pressure confirmed low. Set relief valve to correct pressure. Repair leaks.
HYD-MJ-001.required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.

HYD-SR-001.title: Hydraulic Oil Overtemperature
HYD-SR-001.description: Hydraulic oil temperature P051 = {val} °C, above advisory limit (55 °C). Flow rate P052 = {val2} L/min. Seal degradation accelerates above 60 °C.
HYD-SR-001.probable_cause: Oil cooler fouling, high duty cycle, or low oil level reducing heat dissipation.
diagnostic_steps: Check oil cooler condition
Verify fan operation on cooler
Check oil level
Reduce duty cycle if possible
HYD-SR-001.remedy: Clean oil cooler. Top up oil. Allow temperature to drop before resuming full cycle rate.
HYD-SR-001.required_action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.

HYD-MD-001.title: Hydraulic Pressure — Minor Drift
HYD-MD-001.description: Hydraulic pressure P050 = {val} bar. Drifted {val2} bar below nominal setpoint over last 24 hours.
HYD-MD-001.probable_cause: Minor internal leakage or relief valve creep.
diagnostic_steps: Re-check relief valve setting
Monitor for continued drift
HYD-MD-001.remedy: Adjust relief valve if within range. Log and monitor.
HYD-MD-001.required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.

HYD-WN-001.title: Hydraulic Pump — Scheduled Service Due
HYD-WN-001.description: Hydraulic pump has accumulated {val} operating hours since last service. Service interval is {val2} hours.
HYD-WN-001.remedy: Schedule hydraulic system service per MAINT-HYD-001.
HYD-WN-001.required_action: Log event. No immediate action required. Review at end of shift.
